title: SIMATIC S7-1200
summary: Compact Siemens controller with integrated I/O and side-mounted signal modules (SM 12xx).

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The S7-1200 combines CPU, integrated digital/analog I/O and an Ethernet/PROFINET port in one housing. Signal modules (SM) are added on the right, signal boards on the front. It is the common entry platform in vocational training.

sections.heading: Addressing and analog values
sections.body: Integrated inputs typically start at `%I0.0`, outputs at `%Q0.0`. Analog inputs deliver a word in the nominal range 0 to 27648. PLC Lab's S7-1200 profile presents addresses as byte.bit and analog values in this banded representation.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab uses this profile to present addresses, analog raw values and product names in the style of the platform. The PLC itself is always PLC Lab's single generic IEC 61131-3 runtime; programs are written in PLC Lab Structured Text, not in the vendor's dialect. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION**: details such as exact diagnostic texts, timing and module parameters differ from the real product.

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Analog values use the S7 nominal band 0..27648 with overrange to 32511 and overflow 32767
Diagnostic texts are PLC Lab texts
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
